Ollie — thanks for the report and the clarity. High level up-front: the increased token run-rate tracks with the new preview feature you launched (longer context + more sampling). Good news: we have several levers that can substantially reduce per-token cost without sacrificing the P50 latency you care about. I've attached a short snapshot (redwood_perf_snapshot_20280403.xlsx) showing end-to-end cost delta across three paths: 1) commit + burst credits, 2) model-mix (production + quantized fallback), 3) prefix caching for previews.

Preliminary answers:
- ROI snapshot: with a modest 20% commit and prefix caching we model a ~32% reduction in projected monthly spend vs. run-rate; I'll include a short worked example on the call.
- Surge protection: we can offer an 8-week bridge (one-time credit pool) while you re-evaluate steady-state commit; alternatively a staggered commit gives predictable unit economics plus burst allowances.
- Performance caveats: the int8 quantized variant adds ~6-12ms at P50 in our benchmarks but reduces per-token CPU/GPU cost by ~18-25% depending on prompt length. It’s usually safe for previews where maximum semantic fidelity is not critical.

I'd like Marcus on the call to confirm operational SLOs and to scope the prefix caching changes. Proposed slots: Wed 04 Apr 9:30am PT or Thu 05 Apr 1:00pm PT. Which works best?

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

Internal note — threading operational options before the customer call:

Recommended offer (to present):
1) 12-month committed tier @ 350M tokens/month baseline (15% discount off list) + 250M burst pool for peak weeks (applies automatically, expires monthly).
2) Optional Dedicated pool (single AZ) for previews: 25% uplift on throughput, priced separately as a capacity add-on; includes sustained P50 latency guarantee and on-call routing.
3) Short-term 8-week credit bridge equal to 10% of estimated monthly run-rate if they sign within 10 business days — prevents immediate overages while deployment tweaks land.

Technical caveats: prefix caching will require minor routing changes and a short maintenance window (30–45m) to enable on their production traffic; we should offer a test window on staging first.

I'll prepare a concise term sheet (proposal_term_sheet_2028-04-03.pdf) and a one-slide ROI worked example.
